text:
ana: Onboarding comet-32k-int3 to staging. After long prefills (~30k tokens) with alternating short system lines and multi-paragraph user prompts, generation diverges from fp32 baseline. KV inspect shows single-index fingerprint bump at high offsets. Repro steps + short logs below.

ana: repro (staging):
```
python -m tests.kv_onboard --model comet-32k-int3 --quant int3 --prefill tests/data/alt_short_long.txt --max-tokens 30500 --kv-inspect --kv-dump 10:10
```

ana: short log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-10T09:03:10Z] kv_inspect: idx=30012 fp_before=0x9c7f2a fp_after_prefill=0x9c7f2b (bump)
[2026-03-10T09:03:10Z] gen: mismatch at pos=30013 expected="ing" got="in"
```

tom: did you try --preserve-order? sounds like async prefetch merge ordering or tiled-slot collision.

ana: not yet. float32 matches baseline. suspect quant rounding amplifying rotary interpolation error at large positions. model cfg: rotary_base=10000.0, pos_scale=1.008, rotary_interp=linear. kv args default: --kv-tile 256 --kv-stride 32.

li: quick experiments to run: 1) dense mapping (--kv-stride 1 --kv-tile 65536), 2) preserve-order true, 3) rotary_interp=nearest, 4) pos_scale=1.0. If dense mapping removes bump, tile/stride arithmetic likely.

sam: also add a tiny dump printing `idx,key_hash,fp_before,fp_after,token_window` for the failing range so diffs are compact.

triage-bot: Canary deploy started: comet-32k-int3 int3 -> staging (canary-id: cb-20260310-77). Logs in /var/log/onboard/comet/cb-77.log

ana: kicked off the three runs (preserve-order, dense-index, nearest-interp). Will attach minimal diffs here when done. ETA ~20m.

tom: good. if preserve-order fixes it, add deterministic merge test in prefetcher v2. if dense-index fixes it, add runtime collision assert in tiled mapper.

li: also try compressing the alternating pattern into repeated short-only prefills to reach same absolute idx; that separates absolute position vs interleaving content effect.

ana: will run that too and post results. thanks all. :coffee:
